risk_note: RV2 (content dictionary read). GET /v1/dict (anonymous; getDict leaves planned) returns the dictionary at the current dict_version: dict_version is read from config_items like /v1/config ('0' when absent); only a decimal positive integer queries dict_items, '0' or another value returns that version with empty items (warn except absent / '0', L47); each (dict, code) takes its highest row with version <= current, a null text is not sent and does not fall back; dict_version and the rows are read in one read-only REPEATABLE READ transaction so a concurrent publish never mixes versions; cached 60 s per app_id on the injected clock, the version query parameter is only a hint; without a database 50001. Rebased onto F1-02n (both providers kept). No funds. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
